name: Field Doctor-Style Teriyaki Salmon + Whole Grain Rice (Low FODMAP)
ingredients:
800 g Whole grain rice
495 g Salmon (FISH)
355 g Broccoli
320 g Edamame (SOY bean)
280 g Red Quinoa
160 g Spinach
85 g Tamari [water, SOYA beans, sea salt]
1/2 Red Peppers
5 tbsp Pumpkin Seed
1 1/2 tbsp Ginger
1 1/2 tbsp Red Wine Vinegar
2 tbsp Tapioca Starch
2 tsp Brown Sugar
1/4 Lime Juice
3.5 g Chives
directions:
1. Grains: Rinse and cook wholegrain rice and red quinoa until tender; drain and mix. Keep warm.

2. Glaze: Warm tamari, grated ginger, brown sugar, red wine vinegar, lime juice and a little water. Thicken with tapioca slurry until glossy.

3. Veg: Stir-fry broccoli, edamame and red pepper in extra virgin olive oil until tender-crisp; wilt in spinach. Season lightly.

4. Salmon: Sear salmon pieces in extra virgin olive oil until just cooked. Toss with most of the glaze.

5. Assemble: Bowl up grains, top with vegetables and glazed salmon. Finish with remaining glaze, toasted pumpkin seeds and chives.
 
Cool, portion into 8, refrigerate up to 3 days or freeze; reheat until piping hot.
description:
Ingredients: Whole grain rice, Salmon (FISH), Water, Broccoli, Edamame (SOY bean), Red Quinoa, Spinach, Extra Virgin Olive Oil...

Home recreation inspired by Field Doctor Teriyaki Salmon + Whole Grain Rice (Low FODMAP) (~397 g ready meal). Scaled to 8 portions. Not an official Field Doctor recipe. https://www.fielddoctor.co.uk/products/teriyaki-salmon
notes:
REVERSE-ENGINEERED from Field Doctor published ingredients for personal home cooking only. Official meal is Monash Low FODMAP certified at single-serve size.

Scaling notes
Scaled for 8 portions from Field Doctor single serve (~397 g x 8 = 3176 g).
Unlabelled amounts inferred from UK descending-weight ingredient order (each item <= the one above and >= the one below; leftover mass shared on that basis, not equally).
Spoon measures use ingredient density (g per tsp) then round to kitchen fractions.
Amounts above 50 g are rounded to the nearest 5 g for cooking convenience.
Sweet peppers ~140 g each; carrots ~80 g; sweet potatoes ~130 g; courgettes ~175 g; aubergines ~250 g; swedes ~800 g; plum tomatoes = 400 g tins; lemon ~45 ml / lime ~30 ml juice.
Duplicate label ingredients merged (higher amount kept).
Liquid for home cooking: cook rice, quinoa, pasta, noodles and potatoes in water as you normally would (salt the water; drain where appropriate). For sauces, braises and stir-fry glazes, add water or stock gradually until the consistency is right — do not try to measure the ready-meal's residual water.
Low FODMAP: no onion or garlic bulbs — use chives / green tops only. Inspired recreation from Field Doctor ingredients, not an official recipe.
Chives listed in grams to match fresh packs (e.g. Waitrose Cooks' Ingredients Chives, 20 g).
Ready-meal residual water was ~374 g (inferred ~11.77% from list order) and is not listed as an ingredient.
Oil for home cooking: where Extra Virgin Olive Oil was only a cooking fat on the label, it is omitted from ingredients — fry, soften, sear or roast in extra virgin olive oil as needed. It is kept as an ingredient on richer/oil-forward dishes (e.g. pesto-style sauces or high oil content).
Ready-meal residual Extra Virgin Olive Oil was ~106 g (inferred ~3.35% from list order) and is treated as cooking fat (fry in extra virgin olive oil) rather than a measured ingredient.
